metadata.description: Fabric workspace ID (GUID) that hosts the Eventstream. Obtain via GET /v1/workspaces after workspace creation. Empty at Bicep composition time when provisioned post-deploy; the companion PS1 refuses to run until the manifest carries it.
Fully-qualified Event Hubs namespace hostname (e.g. evh-ihzhhpf-sit-xxxx.servicebus.windows.net). Passed from the data-foundation/eventhubs module output.
Event Hub name carrying the skills-event envelopes. Routing is by the eventKind message property; the Eventstream filters to the three allowed kinds.
Consumer group the Eventstream subscribes to for skills events. Dedicated group keeps this lane isolated from the capacity/fabric consumer groups. Only used when sourceMode=EventHub.

Eventstream source transport. CustomEndpoint (design D4 demo-scope, ADR-0013) mirrors the working es-capacity-events-sit lane: the Container Apps publisher POSTs DC-SKILL-EVENT-v1 envelopes to the Eventstream ingestion URL — fully live-deployable today, no out-of-band Fabric-managed connection required. EventHub is the Swiss-GA target-state and requires a Fabric-managed connection to the Event Hubs namespace (POST /v1/connections) before the post-deploy script can wire it.
Deployment region. switzerlandnorth (ADR-0003 default) or westus2 (ADR-0013 demo-scope carve-out).
True when the module deploys under the ADR-0013 demo-scope carve-out (US region, synthetic data only, no PHI). Recorded in the manifest so post-deploy enforces the PHI-gate downstream.
Display name for the Eventstream item in the Fabric workspace.

eventstreamDescription.defaultValue: Sprint 23 WS-A4 (D4) — near-real-time skills events (credential expiry, consent grant/revoke, newly-confirmed assertion); routes by eventKind, appends to bronze/skills-events/ Delta.

metadata.description: Destination Lakehouse ID (GUID) that receives Delta append writes at bronze/skills-events/. Empty defers destination wiring to a follow-up post-deploy pass.
Destination Lakehouse table prefix under bronze/ for skills events.
Skills-events Eventstream configuration manifest consumed by the post-deploy REST script.
The exact three near-real-time event kinds this lane carries (design D4).
Human-readable status for the parent orchestration.
Path (repo-relative) to the companion post-deploy script that materialises the Eventstream via Fabric REST API.
